checkout.accept: I have read and accept the booking terms, the cancellation table and the privacy notice below
checkout.privacy: Personal data: the shop is the data controller and SHARK is the data processor acting for the shop. We use your name, phone and email only to manage this booking and contact you about the trip, keep them for the period the shop sets under the law, and you can ask the shop to see, correct or delete them.
checkout.receiptNote: The shop issues your receipt after payment is received (a tax invoice if the shop is VAT-registered)
checkout.legal: You book directly with the shop. Prices are itemised. Fees collected on behalf of others (such as marine park fees) are passed on and are not refunded under the cancellation table.
